name: influxdb2
description: influxdb2 — InfluxDB v2 CLI. Query, write, manage InfluxDB time-series databases. Uses Flux language.

install_steps: curl -LO https://dl.influxdata.com/influxdb/releases/influxdb2-2.7.11-linux-amd64.tar.gz && tar xzf influxdb2-2.7.11-linux-amd64.tar.gz && sudo mv influxdb2-2.7.11-linux-amd64/influx /usr/local/bin/ && rm -rf influxdb2*
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or package manager.
